P.flaw: The pole pokes out below the belly plate in an odd arrow-shaped spike.

Q.flaw: Plainer horse with no mane, so the head and neck read less strongly from below.

model-1.why_top: P has a more characterful horse with mane, bridle and clear pole-through-body read while still meeting the budget, size and closed hatched belly.

Q.flaw: The arm overlaps the lamp housing from the front, partly hiding where the lamp sits.

model-2.why_top: Q's chunky, clearly raised red arm with its white stripe reads as clear from cab distance, which is the core purpose of the prop.
